raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DSv4.1 request-window metadata rebuilds request groups after causal expansion has already identified each row's request. Reuse group IDs and group boundaries from that producer to avoid the separate grouping scan. In sampled eager prefill, main and bounded-tail metadata each used the new path; the old grouping scan issued 16 CUDA launches per call.

## Modifications

- Add optional group/first/last outputs to causal expansion and pass them to request-window layout construction.
- Preserve grouping by adjacent actual request IDs, including zero-length entries, repeated IDs, and padding after an empty final entry.
- Admit CUDA, contiguous inputs, CP1, nonempty eager metadata outside capture/full-prefill-graph construction. Existing defaults and unsupported paths retain the original scan. No persistent graph-buffer fields change.

## Accuracy Tests

- Local directed validation: 30 CUDA cases covering int32/int64 request IDs, nonzero storage offsets, 4,224/33,792 rows, eight requests of 4,224 rows, request-count boundaries 17/33/65, zero lengths, repeated IDs and padding. Producer outputs and every request-window layout field match the original implementation exactly. Two additional graph replays verify the unchanged default producer; these are not layout-capture coverage.
- Actual-model diagnostic: both ranks, two measured samples per main/tail path, at 4K and 32K new tokens per rank. All 12 layout fields match the original scan on identical actual inputs. The 32K inputs contain eight requests of 4,224 rows and the corresponding eight 128-row tails.
- Paired native GSM8K using the standard `DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin.test_gsm8k` recipe (200 examples, 64 threads, max 4,096 output tokens): baseline 97.0%, candidate 97.5%, both above the 95% threshold. Canonical example IDs and input hashes match exactly. Both runs have zero errors, truncations, invalid results, or empty generations. Simulation is disabled (`SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=-1`); actual DSpark acceptance is enabled. This is quality validation, not a native-latency comparison or proof of identical generated text.

The helper validation remains local; this PR adds no standalone benchmark or registered helper test.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Full-model steady engine-step measurements use the unchanged `benchmark/engine_steps/bench_engine_steps.py` from #46006 at `543a2804d5c8f3167c8fd8bb5c3a3ef862c3774f`. These measure prefill step cost, not end-to-end application latency.

Two GB300 GPUs; same public DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash checkpoint and runtime in both arms; TP2/EP2, attention-DP2, DP1, MegaMoE, `flashmla_mega`, encoder and decoder bounded replay enabled. Full prefill/decode graph backends disabled. Context 131,072, suffix 4,096, 4,096 requests per attention rank, seed 733427905. `SGLANG_DP_USE_GATHERV=0`, sparse prefill enabled, Engram extend hash disabled. The step benchmark uses `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.51` with `match-expected` and `real-draft-token`; native quality is evaluated separately with simulation disabled. Requested KV limit is 54,000,000 in every arm (resolved 53,999,872 per rank).

A = baseline, B = this change. Each value is ms/step from the official scorer; all saved completions re-score exactly and all workload/configuration guards pass.

| New tokens/rank | Order | Step times (ms) | Paired throughput changes |
|---:|---|---|---|
|32,768|A/B/B/A|338.139311 / 337.759779 / 337.737367 / 338.099151|+0.112367% / +0.107120%|
|32,768, independent confirmation|B/A/A/B|337.663403 / 337.903846 / 338.036303 / 337.681297|+0.071208% / +0.105130%|
|4,096|A/B/B/A|89.071866 / 88.755849 / 87.694311 / 87.558688|+0.356052% / −0.154655%|

The measured 32K benefit is small: approximately 0.24–0.38 ms per 337–338 ms step. The 4K result is mixed and does not establish a benefit. No pooled average or speedup claim is made for 4K. In-flight depth is 8 for 32K and 32 for 4K; replay-inclusive compute rows are 33,792 and 4,224 per rank, respectively.

The observed launch reduction motivated the change; profiled CPU/device durations are not used as an E2E savings estimate. Native quality passed separately. Related CI was dispatched on the measured candidate head: [encoder replay CPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40152193503), [request-window copy](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40152201756), [DSpark kernel parity](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40152209844), and [native GSM8K model regression](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40152217963). All four selected test jobs passed, including the native GSM8K model regression. These CI results do not change the limited 32K engine-step performance claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Configured pre-commit checks passed on the candidate.
- [x] Local correctness and paired step measurements recorded.
- [x] Paired standard native accuracy completed.
- [x] Related existing CI tests dispatched.
- [x] Related CI results checked and passed.

<details>
<summary>32K official-script reproduction command</summary>

Use the public checkpoint revision below and the same runtime in both arms. Runtime used: PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Triton 3.8.0, FlashInfer 0.7.2, sgl-deep-gemm0.2.3.post2, sgl-flash-mla1.0.0, deepseek-recipe0.2.0. Machine-specific RDMA interface/address and an owned Mooncake master are prerequisites; no internal runner is needed.

```bash
# Run from the baseline or candidate checkout with its matching dependencies.
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 PYTHONPATH="$PWD/python"
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sgl-project/sglang/543a2804d5c8f3167c8fd8bb5c3a3ef862c3774f/benchmark/engine_steps/bench_engine_steps.py -o bench_engine_steps.py
python -c 'import hashlib; assert hashlib.sha256(open("bench_engine_steps.py","rb").read()).hexdigest() == "2f79eb2615e7a4e088b38b66b1a1403bd9d872c9e27d61a91071cea9294b257e"'
MODEL_PATH="$(python -c 'from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; print(snapshot_download("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", revision="314113f8a7dadb388215396ba5fbee2c610a04d6"))')"
# Set RDMA_DEVICE and LOCAL_RDMA_ADDRESS for this machine. Start an owned
# mooncake_master with --port 39271 --enable_http_metadata_server=true
# --http_metadata_server_port=39277 --metrics_port=39297
# --default_kv_lease_ttl=60000 before the benchmark.
export SGLANG_JIT_DEEPGEMM_PRECOMPILE=0
export SGLANG_RUST_BUILD_MODE=auto CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8
export NCCL_IB_HCA=${RDMA_DEVICE:?set the local RDMA interface}
export SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING=1 SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK=1 SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_WAITING_TIMEOUT=900 \
  SGLANG_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE_LAYOUT=per_rank SGLANG_DSV41_REASONING_EFFORT=high SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE=1 \
  SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=65536 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BF16_INDEX_LOGITS=1 SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static \
  SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.51 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token \
  SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900 SGLANG_NUMA_BIND_V2=0 SGLANG_ENABLE_DP_SPEC_PREFILL_COORDINATION=0 SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL=1
export MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL=rdma MOONCAKE_DEVICE=${RDMA_DEVICE:?set the local RDMA interface} MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE=150gb MC_MS_AUTO_DISC=0 \
  MOONCAKE_DEFAULT_KV_LEASE_TTL=60000 MOONCAKE_MASTER=127.0.0.1:39271 MOONCAKE_TE_META_DATA_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:39277/metadata \
  MOONCAKE_LOCAL_HOSTNAME=${LOCAL_RDMA_ADDRESS:?set the local RDMA address}
export SGLANG_LOG_MS=1 SGLANG_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE_CORE_BACKEND=rust
export SGLANG_DP_USE_GATHERV=0 SGLANG_OPT_ENGRAM_EXTEND_HASH=0 SGLANG_OPT_FLASHMLA_SPARSE_PREFILL=1
python bench_engine_steps.py prefill \
  --engine --prefix-source device --dp 2 --num-gpus 2 --context 131072 --new-tokens 4096 --tokens-per-step "32768" \
  --sample-gpu --requests 4096 --in-flight-steps "8" --warmup-steps 5 --timeout 900 --seed 733427905 --server-log prefill.log --out prefill.json --prefill-completions prefill.raw.json \
  --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" \
  --chunked-prefill-size "67584" --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 1 --data-parallel-size 1 --attn-dp-size 2 --disable-prefill-cuda-graph --disable-decode-cuda-graph \
  --dsv4-attn-backend flashmla_mega --enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay --enable-dp-lm-head \
  --enable-metrics --expert-parallel-size 2 --max-running-requests 256 --mem-fraction-static 0.9 --max-total-tokens 54000000 --moe-a2a-backend megamoe \
  --random-seed 733427905 --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
  --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.12 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --trust-remote-code \
  --watchdog-timeout 3600 --skip-server-warmup --enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay --max-prefill-tokens "33792" \
  --enable-unified-cache-external-linker --unified-cache-external-linker-backend mooncake \
  --hicache-storage-backend-extra-config '{"enable_group_semantics":true}' \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 39270 --nccl-port 39272 > prefill.log 2>&1
```

For 4K, change tokens-per-step to 4096, in-flight-steps to 32, chunked-prefill-size to 8704, and max-prefill-tokens to 4224; keep every other setting fixed across arms. Use distinct generic output filenames for each ABBA/BAAB arm. The reported source heads are 773cb938fe9484a8f7e7e46fb1b1fe96412c59ed and be99f909b9699631e2c1ff4000351405e6d49ebf; patch application to current main was checked separately and is not a benchmark of a new source head.
</details>

files.patch:
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@ def _inputs_on_cuda(*args, **kwargs) -> bool:
 class ExpandPrefillCausallyResult(msgspec.Struct):
     seq_lens_casual: torch.Tensor
     req_pool_indices_repeated: torch.Tensor
+    window_groups: Optional[tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None
 
 
 class ExpandPrefillCausally:
@@ -45,6 +46,7 @@ def torch(
         extend_seq_lens_cpu: Optional[list[int]],
         num_tokens: int,
         padded_num_tokens: Optional[int],
+        return_window_groups: bool = False,
     ) -> ExpandPrefillCausallyResult:
         return expand_prefill_causally(
             req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
@@ -69,13 +71,15 @@ def triton(
         extend_seq_lens_cpu: Optional[list[int]],
         num_tokens: int,
         padded_num_tokens: Optional[int],
+        return_window_groups: bool = False,
     ) -> ExpandPrefillCausallyResult:
         return expand_prefill_causally_triton(
             req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
             seq_lens=seq_lens,
             extend_seq_lens=extend_seq_lens,
             num_tokens=num_tokens,
             padded_num_tokens=padded_num_tokens,
+            return_window_groups=return_window_groups,
         )
 
 
@@ -156,18 +160,27 @@ def expand_prefill_causally(
     )
 
 
+@triton.jit
+def _window_group_max(a, b):
+    return tl.maximum(a, b)
+
+
 @triton.jit
 def _expand_prefill_causally_kernel(
     req_pool_ptr,
     seq_lens_ptr,
     extend_seq_lens_ptr,
     seq_lens_casual_ptr,
     req_pool_repeated_ptr,
+    group_ptr,
+    first_ptr,
+    last_ptr,
     bs,
     num_tokens,
     total_tokens,
     BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
     BS_P2: tl.constexpr,
+    WINDOW_GROUPS: tl.constexpr,
 ):
     offs = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
     mask = offs < total_tokens
@@ -195,6 +208,30 @@ def _expand_prefill_causally_kernel(
     tl.store(seq_lens_casual_ptr + offs, causal, mask=mask)
     tl.store(req_pool_repeated_ptr + offs, rp, mask=mask)
 
+    if WINDOW_GROUPS:
+        # Empty request slots emit no rows. Padding emits the final slot's ID,
+        # even when that slot has no real rows. Group adjacent *IDs*, not slots.
+        active = bmask & ((extend > 0) | ((b == bs - 1) & (total_tokens > num_tokens)))
+        latest = tl.associative_scan(tl.where(active, b + 1, 0), 0, _window_group_max)
+        previous = tl.gather(latest, tl.maximum(b - 1, 0), 0)
+        previous = tl.where(b > 0, previous, 0)
+        ids = tl.load(req_pool_ptr + b, mask=bmask, other=0)
+        previous_ids = tl.gather(ids, tl.maximum(previous - 1, 0), 0)
+        begins = active & ((previous == 0) | (ids != previous_ids))
+        before = b[None, :] <= r[:, None]
+        group = tl.sum((begins[None, :] & before).to(tl.int32), 1) - 1
+        first = tl.max(tl.where(begins[None, :] & before, start_locs[None, :], 0), 1)
+        last = (
+            tl.min(
+                tl.where(begins[None, :] & ~before, start_locs[None, :], total_tokens),
+                1,
+            )
+            - 1
+        )
